tests: ${ProjectID} in Build Output Path becomes an empty string
steps:
1. Open a saved Standard EXE project named BuildProbeExe, which has a Project ID.
2. In Project Settings, set Build Output Path to ${SourcePath}\Build\${ProjectID}_${ProjectName}.${FileExtension}.
3. Press Build. The exe is written as Build\_BuildProbeExe.exe: ${ProjectID} became an empty string.
Control: ${SourcePath}, ${ProjectName} and ${FileExtension} in the same path are expanded.
